meta_title: Pono — set it down, it holds
meta_description: The control room for agent-built projects. Your repository, database and hosting stay in your name.
access_request_body: Which project do you want to set down first?
hero_title_rest: Your app holds, and it’s yours.
hero_lede: Your agent writes the code. Pono holds the real state of every project and refuses what would break production. Your repository, database and hosting stay in your name.
hero_fine_rest: on your providers’ free tiers. No AI credits.
proof_refused_title: A migration drops a table in production.
proof_refused_body: Nothing ran. This refusal comes from the system, not from the agent.
problem_title: If you have to search for the answer, your projects aren’t being held.
problem_q1: You have several projects online. Which one is still running?
problem_q2: Which database is wired to which?
problem_q3: Who deployed last, and what went out?
benefits_title: The real state, the guardrails and your quotas, in one place.
benefit_state_title: Every project, as it really is
benefit_state_body: Environments, last deployment, links that work. Read from your providers, never typed by hand.
benefit_guardrails_body: Nothing ships without your approval. The refusal is mechanical: your agent cannot argue its way past it.
benefit_quotas_body: Your free tiers are watched. The alert arrives before your site stops.
mechanism_title: Your agent writes. Pono holds. Everything stays yours.
mechanism_intro: You stay in Claude, Codex or ChatGPT — the one you already pay for. Pono doesn’t resell intelligence: it holds the state and the rules.
mechanism_ready_body: No secret in the repository · preview checked · additive migrations. Only your approval is missing.
limit_not_editor: It isn’t a code editor: you stay in your agent.
limit_no_ai_resale: No AI resold by the meter.
faq_title: What people ask before setting a project down.
faq_for_me_answer: If you already build with an agent and your projects are scattered, yes.
faq_if_pono_stops_answer: Your projects keep running: they live on your accounts, not ours.
faq_why_not_replit_answer: Replit builds fast, and well. Pono holds what gets built, and doesn’t keep it.
faq_price_answer: A fixed price, never credits. Free tiers are enough to start.
cta_title: Which project do you want to set down first?
cta_body: Access on request while Pono is being built.
error_auth_not_allowed: This account doesn’t have access to Pono yet.
error_auth_session_required: Your session expired. Sign in again.
error_auth_state_mismatch: The sign-in could not be verified. Try again.
error_auth_provider_refused: The code host refused the sign-in.
error_project_already_imported: This repository is already a project in your workshop.
error_project_repository_unreachable: This repository is not reachable with your connection.
error_provider_unavailable: The provider is not answering. The last known state is kept.
reason_connection_expired: A connection it needs has expired or was revoked.
empty_body: Connect your code host, then import a repository: Pono reads its state from your providers.
verdict_project_production_down_body: Two 10-second attempts, no answer. Check the host.
verdict_project_deployment_failed_body: The live version may be the previous one. The log is at the host.
verdict_connection_expired_body: Pono keeps the last known state, dated, until you connect it again.
verdict_project_manifest_proposed: A manifest awaits your merge on {name}.
verdict_project_manifest_proposed_body: Once merged, it becomes the project's source of truth. Pono never merges.
verdict_project_quota_warning_body: The provider will pause the service at the limit.
verdict_project_quota_critical_body: The pause is close. Reduce usage or change plan.
detail_refresh_queued: Reading requested. It shows here in a few seconds.
detail_stale: A provider did not answer the last reading: these values date from {when}.
manifest_present: Present in the repository: it is the source of truth.
manifest_absent: Absent: the state is deduced from the providers.
import_intro: Pick a repository. Pono reads its manifest, or proposes one as a pull request: you type nothing.
import_empty: No reachable repository. Add repositories to the Pono app installation.
connections_intro: Pono reads your providers and deploys nothing. Keys are encrypted and every use is traced.
code_host_body: Install the Pono app on the repositories you choose, then link it. No key is asked.
error_connection_code_host_not_installed: The Pono app is not installed on your account yet.
error_connection_provider_unsupported: This provider is not supported, or its address is missing.
error_service_code_host_unconfigured: The service has no code host configured.
error_service_database_unconfigured: The service has no database configured.
error_service_unreachable: The service does not answer right now.
detail_no_quotas: No quota tracked for this project.
error_service_identity_unconfigured: The service has no identity provider configured.
error_service_providers_unconfigured: The service has no providers configured.
